resources.string: Make sure the Mac is on and MacTV is installed. Menu key → Settings to enter its address.
The TV\'s video decoder is busy
The TV system kept its decoder for live TV. Restart the TV and try again.
On the Mac, run: mactv pair\nthen enter the six-digit PIN it shows.
That PIN was not right. Run mactv pair again for a new one.
The connection to the Mac was lost
Wake signal sent to the Mac
The Mac is there, but its picture stopped. Other apps on the TV are not affected.
The Mac answers, but its MacTV host is not streaming (run mactv doctor on the Mac).
The Mac can\'t be found: asleep, off, or not on this network.
Menu key: menu · Hold back: leave
Menu or back to close · Hold back to leave
Pointer mode: arrows move, OK clicks
Key mode: arrows and OK go to the Mac as keys
